user_requirement_verbatim: các ảnh có bị mờ hay khó nhìn không, tôi muốn ảnh phải đảm bảo rõ nét nhé
assessment_scope: Dimensions checked for all 79 crops; native-size visual spot checks: P017-01, P058-02, P067-02, P070-01, P030-01. No website exists for final display-size validation.
interpretation: Pixel budgets indicate available sampling density, not a sharpness certification. At DPR 2 both displayed width and height must be <= half the corresponding source dimension to avoid pixel enlargement; object-fit:cover can require a larger source. Existing blur/compression/fade remains.
implementation_criteria: Check final image boxes on desktop/mobile and DPR 1/2; verify legibility visually.
Do not enlarge low-resolution crops to fit a larger image box and label them quality-approved.
Preserve approved layout; if the required box exceeds source capacity, mark source resolution insufficient and obtain a larger original or an approved replacement.
No AI restoration, unrequested upscaling, sharpening, deblurring or hidden-content recovery.
Never modify original maps; keep full legends and labels and provide access to the original file when implemented.
